job.title: Business Development Manager
job.description:
This is a rare opportunity to step into a newly created Business Development role where your success will come from your ability to build trust, listen well and develop genuine relationships with different sized business owners. 
Joining an established, purpose-driven national organisation entering an important period of growth, you will help identify and progress potential business transition and acquisition opportunities across a highly regulated services environment. 

This is not traditional transactional sales. There are no hard-sell conversations. 
Instead, you will engage business owners and senior decision-makers, understand their circumstances and future plans, and create the trust needed to explore whether there is a genuine opportunity to work together. 

As the COO describes it: “It is relationship selling. It’s not sales sales. It is about being able to listen.” 

For many of the people you will engage, their business represents years of hard work, deeply established customer relationships and strong connections with their employees and communities. Your role is to understand what matters to them, recognise when the timing may be right and help progress meaningful commercial conversations. 

Why this role? 
  • $90,000–$110,000 + super 
  • Brisbane based hybrid role – 2/3 
  • Newly created position working closely with the COO 
  • Join an established and growing national organisation 
  • Work from an existing pipeline and identified target market 
  • Relationship-led business development rather than aggressive transactional selling 
  • Engage directly with business owners, CEOs and senior decision-makers 
  • Opportunity to contribute to a significant growth strategy 
  • Strong internal support, established market intelligence and existing prospect information 
  • Develop exposure to business acquisitions and commercial transitions 
  • Purpose-driven environment where people remain central to commercial decisions 
  • Collaborative and experienced leadership team 
  • 9-month fixed-term contract with potential future opportunities based on business requirements and performance 
As Business Development Manager – B2B Acquisition, you will be responsible for developing and progressing a structured pipeline of prospective organisations. 

There is already an established target market and previous engagement with a number of organisations, giving you a strong platform from which to begin. 
Your role will involve re-engaging existing contacts, initiating new conversations, building relationships and understanding where each organisation may be in its thinking.  You will conduct discovery conversations, identify genuine commercial opportunities and progress those relationships to the point where senior leaders can become involved. 

You will not be expected to undertake formal due diligence or manage the financial and legal transaction yourself. Your strength will be creating the opportunity, qualifying it and ensuring the right conversations happen at the right time. 

Key responsibilities 

In this role, you will: 
  • Re-engage existing prospects and develop new business opportunities 
  • Build trusted relationships with business owners, CEOs and senior decision-makers 
  • Conduct consultative discovery conversations to understand each organisation’s circumstances, priorities and future plans 
  • Identify and qualify potential transition and acquisition opportunities 
  • Manage a structured pipeline of prospects at different stages 
  • Develop and maintain regular follow-up with longer-term opportunities 
  • Tailor conversations and messaging to suit the individual organisation and stakeholder 
  • Present a compelling, values-led commercial proposition 
  • Coordinate introductions between qualified prospects and senior leadership 
  • Prepare concise briefing information and handover notes 
  • Maintain accurate CRM and pipeline information 
  • Monitor activity, opportunities and conversion across the pipeline 
  • Work closely with internal stakeholders as opportunities progress 
  • Contribute to the ongoing development of outreach strategies and messaging 
About you 

Your industry background is less important than how you sell. 
You may come from media, advertising, travel, professional services, recruitment, financial services, healthcare, technology, insurance or another service-based B2B environment. 
What matters is that you know how to develop relationships rather than simply push a product. 
You will ask good questions, listen carefully and understand that the strongest commercial outcome may take several conversations to develop. 
You will be comfortable initiating contact and progressing opportunities, but equally comfortable slowing the conversation down when the situation requires it. 
You will bring: 
  • Demonstrated experience in B2B business development, relationship management or a similar commercially focused role 
  • Ideally 4–5+ years’ experience within a consultative sales or service-based environment  
  • Proven ability to build relationships with business owners and senior decision-makers 
  • Strong questioning, listening and discovery skills 
  • High emotional intelligence and strong interpersonal skills 
  • Commercial acumen and the ability to identify genuine business opportunities 
  • Confidence communicating with CEOs, executives and senior stakeholders 
  • Strong organisation, follow-up and pipeline management skills 
  • Ability to manage multiple relationships at different stages 
  • Experience working to activity, pipeline and conversion expectations 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills 
  • Ability to tailor your communication style to different people and situations 
  • A genuine interest in working within a purpose-driven organisation 
  • The ability to work independently while remaining highly collaborative 
Previous experience within M&A, corporate advisory, financial services, healthcare or another regulated environment will be highly regarded, however it is not essential. 

The right person may simply be an excellent relationship-based salesperson who understands how to uncover a need, position a solution and build enough trust to progress a significant commercial conversation. 

The Environment 

You will be joining a collaborative organisation where strong commercial performance and positive customer outcomes are equally important. 
The role will work closely with an experienced COO who will provide significant support as you learn the organisation, its proposition and the nuances of the market. 

For this reason, being Brisbane based and spending regular time in the office will be important, particularly during your initial onboarding. 
The organisation operates a hybrid working model, with much of the external relationship development conducted through phone, email and video meetings. 
The successful person will be commercially driven, curious and confident, but they will also have the emotional intelligence to recognise that not every conversation should feel like a sales conversation. 

If you are looking for a Business Development opportunity where listening, relationship building and commercial outcomes genuinely go hand in hand, we would love to hear from you.

job.title: Financial Accounting & Compliance Lead
job.description:
Lead - Financial Accounting & Compliance
Brisbane   12-month fixed-term contract | Circa $170k package + Hybrid work arrangements Financial Accounting | Compliance | Audit | Assurance | Continuous Improvement
Are you an experienced financial accounting professional who enjoys bringing structure, discipline and fresh thinking to established environments?
 
This is an opportunity to join a large, complex and purpose-led organisation in a senior, hands-on financial accounting role with genuine scope to strengthen financial governance, assurance and operating practices.
Working within an established Financial Services function, you will take ownership of core financial accounting deliverables while identifying opportunities to improve processes, strengthen controls, enhance audit readiness and embed more consistent financial practices across a highly decentralised operating environment.
This is not a pure transformation role, nor is it a position where you will simply maintain existing processes. It will suit someone who is comfortable being hands-on technically, while also asking the right questions about why things are done a certain way and where they could be improved.
 
Your key responsibilities will include:
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of accurate and timely annual financial statements and support quarterly financial reporting.
  • Oversee core financial accounting activities including balance sheet integrity, reconciliations, accounting treatments and general ledger governance.
  • Coordinate the external audit process and strengthen organisational audit readiness.
  • Proactively manage audit actions, identifying root causes and ensuring issues are appropriately addressed.
  • Provide authoritative technical advice across Australian Accounting Standards, taxation, grants, funding acquittals and financial reporting.
  • Strengthen financial compliance, assurance and control practices across the organisation.
  • Review existing accounting treatments and historical practices, identifying opportunities to improve accuracy and reduce financial risk.
  • Establish more structured and timely approaches to funding and grant acquittals.
  • Support improvements to corporate card governance, compliance monitoring and exception reporting.
  • Act as the financial accounting SME in the review and development of policies, procedures, guidance and training materials.
  • Provide technical financial accounting input into broader systems, payroll and process initiatives.
  • Identify and progress practical continuous-improvement opportunities that reduce errors, strengthen controls and improve service delivery.
  • Coach and develop an emerging accounting professional, building technical capability and confidence.
The environment
You will be joining a large and decentralised organisation with established systems, processes and ways of working.  While the underlying accounting is not unnecessarily complex, the scale and operating model create an environment where consistency, governance and financial stewardship are critical.
There is significant opportunity to review practices that have evolved over time and determine whether they remain appropriate, efficient and compliant.
Success will require someone who can quickly distinguish between:
  • genuine financial and compliance risk;
  • practices that require immediate attention;
  • opportunities for longer-term improvement; and
  • processes that may simply need clearer guidance, controls or communication.
You will need the judgement to challenge the status quo without trying to change everything at once.
 
About you
You will be an accomplished financial accounting professional who combines strong technical accounting capability with sound judgement and an improvement mindset. 
 
You will ideally bring:
  • Strong experience across financial accounting, statutory reporting and year-end.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating external audit requirements.
  • Excellent knowledge of Australian Accounting Standards.
  • Strong balance sheet, reconciliation and general ledger capability.
  • Experience across financial governance, controls, compliance and assurance.
  • Sound taxation knowledge, including exposure to FBT and broader organisational tax obligations.
  • Experience identifying and improving inefficient or poorly controlled accounting processes.
  • The ability to investigate accounting issues and identify their underlying cause rather than simply correcting the immediate problem.
  • Strong written communication and documentation skills.
  • Experience preparing or reviewing accounting position papers, policies, procedures or technical guidance.
  • The confidence to question established practices constructively.
  • Strong prioritisation skills and the ability to focus effort where it will have the greatest impact.
  • A willingness to remain hands-on and technically involved.
  • The ability to coach and support the development of a less experienced accountant.
Experience gained within government, not-for-profit, professional services or even education or any other large governance-led organisation would be advantageous but is not essential.
Candidates coming from a substantial commercial environment will also be considered where they can demonstrate strong financial accounting, governance and compliance capability.
Previous chartered accounting or professional practice experience would also be well regarded.
You will hold relevant tertiary qualifications in accounting, finance, commerce or a related discipline, together with CA/CPA membership or demonstrated progress toward professional membership.
 
What will make you successful?
Technical competence is important, but the strongest candidate will also bring the ability to look at an established financial environment and determine: What is the risk? What actually matters? What should we improve first?
You will be pragmatic rather than theoretical, comfortable working within established governance structures and able to bring others with you as financial practices progressively mature.
Strong written communication will be particularly important, as will your ability to translate technical accounting requirements into practical guidance for stakeholders who may not have a finance background.

Why consider this opportunity?
